description: This file defines the 'SitemapValuesAddressScheme' class, which implements route endpoint finding logic for sitemaps in OrchardCore, utilizing caching and route matching based on sitemap IDs and global route values.

classes.name: SitemapValuesAddressScheme
classes.description: Implements route endpoint resolution for sitemaps, caching endpoints based on route paths and values, and matching route values against global options.

methods.name: SitemapValuesAddressScheme
methods.description: Constructor initializing entries and options for sitemap route resolution.

methods.name: FindEndpoints
methods.description: Finds and returns route endpoints matching the given address, utilizing caching and route value filtering.

methods.name: Match
methods.description: Checks if the explicit route values match the global route values specified in options.
